SA-34
SUSPENSION ANO AXLE - FRONT SHOCK ABSOHBEH
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE FRONT WHEEL
Torque: 103 N-m (1,050 kgf,cm, 76 fHbf)
2. DISCONNECT ABS SPEED SENSOR WIRE HARNESS
CLAMPS FROM SHOCK ABSORBER
Remove the bolt and disconnect the ABS speed sensor v.-11 e
harness clamp.
Torque: 8.0 N-m (82 kgf,cm, 71 in .. lbf)
3. DISCONNECT FLEXIBLE HOSE
Remove the bolt and disconnect the flexible hose from the
shock absorber bracket
Torque: 19 N•m (192 kgf-cm, 14 ft-lbf)
4. DISCONNECT STABILIZER BAR LINK
Rernove the nut and disconnect the stabilizer bar link from the
shock absorber.
Torque: 44 N-m {449 kgf-cm, 32 ft-lbf)
HINT:
!I the ball joint turns together with the nut, use a hexagon (5 rnrn)
wrench to hold the stud.
5. REMOVE SHOCK ABSORBER WITH COIL SPRING
N {a) Loosen the 2 nuts on the lower side of shock absorber.
Torque: 153 N,m (1,560 kgf.cm, 113 ft,lbf)
HINT:
Do not remove the 2 bolts.
(b) Remove the 3 nuts on the upper side of the shock absorb•
er.
Torque: 39 N-m (400 kgf.cm, 29 ft,lbf)
(c) Remove the 2 nuts and bolts on the lower side of shock
absorber.
HINT:
At the time of installation, coat the nut's thread with engine oil.
(d) Remove the shock absorber with coil spring.
